Case Study: Retail Franchise

An organic video strategy that outperformed paid ads

The client's holiday launch needed reach without a bigger media budget. I built a video campaign featuring their own employees, authentic, relatable, and built to travel. This case study covers one of the several retail brand locations I managed social media for as part of a multi-brand client relationship.

Across two employee-led reels in the campaign, the account reached 12,879 and 16,877 accounts respectively, with one landing 210% above the client's typical reel performance. Overall, the campaign drove an average performance increase of more than 445% in organic reach, 714% in likes and 940% in shares.

16,877Accounts reached, best-performing reel

Case Study: Interior Design Studio

Brand recognition built to bring in new clients

This client came to me with a brand new Instagram presence: a handful of posts and almost no engagement, with no real way for potential clients to discover them online. Their goal from the start was for Instagram to generate real clients, not just followers. I turned the account into a self-contained brand hub, giving visitors everything they needed to know about the studio without ever leaving Instagram, backed by a consistent content strategy across formats built to get new eyes on the brand and convert that attention into people who wanted to follow, inquire, and work with them.

The studio's projects began getting featured and credited on the pages of recognized design and furniture brands, including Le Cornue and West Elm. That kind of third party recognition signaled to anyone discovering the account that this was a serious, credible name in the industry, which made people more likely to reach out. New client inquiries started coming directly through the account as people saw the content, trusted what they were seeing, and reached out wanting to work with the studio.

Top 2Instagram search rank for "Toronto interior designer"
Le Cornue + West ElmAmong the recognized brands that featured their work
InboundNew client inquiries generated directly through Instagram
Case Study: Wellness Coach

Turning a growth standstill into sustainable momentum

This client's Instagram account was still new and had stalled out, with little movement in reach or new followers. The goal was to kickstart growth with strategies built to last, attracting the right audience and building long term loyalty rather than chasing a quick spike. I introduced new content formats, leaning into reels and carousels to expand reach, optimized the account to convert new viewers into followers, and put a consistent posting schedule in place to keep the algorithm working in the account's favor.

Measured over a 90 day period, the account went from a standstill to real momentum. Reach and engagement both grew several times over compared to the previous period, and followers climbed steadily as more of that new audience chose to stick around.

75.9KAccounts reached in 90 days (+4,292% vs. prior period)
4,053Accounts engaged over the same period (+1,574%)
1,731Followers gained vs. the prior period (+16.7%)
